requirements.requirement: The author was promoted from associate professor to professor in 2022 at the same university where the author completed both undergraduate and graduate degrees.
The author pursued their PhD abroad at a Canadian university under the guidance of an Iranian professor.
The Iranian professor who was the author's PhD advisor had dreamt of becoming a writer but switched to mathematics at the end of high school and got their doctorate in Minnesota.
The author published a book connecting mathematics to an ancient technique for liberation 20 years after completing their PhD.
The author published a journal article on a similar topic six years after publishing the book.
The title of that journal article.
